mode.toggleAria: Choose whether a character must match any or all of the selected values

capacity.type: Switched to "Any": a character has at most {{max}} types, so "All" can never match {{count}}.
capacity.class: Switched to "Any": a character has at most {{max}} classes, so "All" can never match {{count}}.

disjoint.type: No character carries every selected type, so nothing matches. Switch to "Any" or remove one.
disjoint.class: No character carries every selected class, so nothing matches. Switch to "Any" or remove one.

support.empty: Pick one or more values. Nothing selected means no filter.
support.any: Showing characters that match any of the selected values.
support.all: Showing characters that match every selected value.
